Political commentator @HasanPiker breaks down the concept of technofeudalism—the idea that Big Tech companies have become the new gatekeepers, creating their own rules while profiting from our attention and emotions. He also explains why other countries are taking a different approach to regulating tech companies and what it could mean for the future of the internet.
